official_skill_effect_facts.source: roBrowserLegacy (GPL-3.0) RE dump of the official client tables; only numeric ids, field names and file names are extracted
official_skill_effect_facts.packetver_note: extracted facts (numeric ids, symbolic named-effect references, field names, file names); validated against CondaRO.exe + the GRFs

effect_layer_facts.source: roBrowserLegacy (GPL-3.0) RE dump of the official client EffectTable.js; only numeric ids, field names, file names and playback parameters are extracted
effect_layer_facts.note: js comments stripped before parsing; every layer (STR/SPR/3D/...) and its official playback facts are kept in table order; validated against the CondaRO GRFs by gen_skill_effect_layers.py

provenance.schema: skill_effects.ron v1 (owned by the unified pipeline lane)
provenance.boundary: This lane owns the official EffectTable file layers only. Hard-coded FUNC/callback visuals, procedural primitives, migrated hand-written layers, the merged data file and the Rust loader belong to the pipeline lane (tools/gen_skill_effects.py, skill_effects.ron).

anchor.effectId/successEffectId: Auto (target entity when the packet knows one, else target cell, else caster)
anchor.releaseEffectId/beforeHitEffectId: Target (Travel is reserved for Primitive projectiles)

rules.head: official head flag, emitted as head:true; the client derives vertical:Overhead from it
rules.attached_entity: always explicit, from the official attachedEntity flag (false when absent)

kinds.Str: official type STR; file relative to data\texture\effect\ and ending .str
kinds.Spr: official type SPR / spriteName / absoluteSpriteName; stem relative to data\sprite\
kinds.Texture: official type 3D/2D; file relative to data\texture\
kinds.Cylinder: official type CYLINDER; texture relative to data\texture\; radii/height converted x2 to world units

rules.kept_raw: Texture size/size_end and offset(posx,posy,posz) are raw official values
rules.extractor_fixes: firstHitEffectId is extracted; effect id 0 (EF_HIT1, effect\\pok3.tga) keeps its official layer facts; symbolic SkillEffect references (ef_* / *_ground / *_sound blocks) are resolved for learnable skills; named effect-table blocks are parsed as separate blocks; %d/%s templates are expanded for .str/.spr/texture and wav names
rules.dropped: assets not shipped in the CondaRO GRFs are dropped and listed in statistics.dropped
